It debuted in Japan with the release of the UX-00 Rare Bey Get Battle Prize Booster, [[AeroPegasus 3-70A]], on July 30th, 2024. ==Description== '''AeroPegasus''' is a three-sided Attack Type Blade with three curved upward slanting contact points. '''AeroPegasus''' is a reference to Beyblades from ''[[Metal Fight Beyblade]]'', in this case being the Pegasis line of Beyblades. The Gear Chip features the side profile of [[wikipedia:Pegasus|Pegasus]], a winged horse from Greek mythology and one of the 88 constellations in space. The Gear Chip has a diamond/hexagonal shape in the background that references "Face" parts from the ''Metal Fight Beyblade'' toyline. The three sides create excellent [[Upper Attack]] and [[Smash Attack]]. '''AeroPegasus''' features six "air duct" holes, which are intended to improve aerodynamic performance by reducing drag from air moving through the holes. As part of the ''[[Unique Line]]'', '''AeroPegasus''' has resin Launcher Hooks instead of metal ones, which increase Outward Weight Distribution (OWD). The Unique Line gimmick of '''AeroPegasus''' was initially advertised by Takara Tomy as its "Double Metal Coat", referring to the original release's use of blue and green paint. The ''Red Version'' release simply removes any mention of the Double Metal Coat. At the time of its release, was the heaviest Blade available, heavier than [[Blade - CobaltDrake|CobaltDrake]] and [[Blade - PhoenixWing|PhoenixWing]], which both weighed 38.0 grams on average. However, '''AeroPegasus''' was surpassed by the [[Blade - ImpactDrake|ImpactDrake]] Blade, 5 months later. Despite being outclassed in weight, '''AeroPegasus''' has a superior shape and is heavier than most Defense and Stamina Blades. '''AeroPegasus''' is highly versatile in Attack combinations, and can be used on flat Bits such as [[Bit - Low Flat|Low Flat (LF)]], [[Bit - Low Rush|Low Rush (LR)]], and [[Bit - Level|Level (L)]]. At the time of writing, '''AeroPegasus''' has been a staple part in [[Beyblade Battle Base|B4]] and [[WBO]] tournaments since its release. Releases of '''AeroPegasus''' produced during January 2026 onward have a new reinforced mold that is heavier by 0.5 grams on average. This second mold was first released with the ''Red Version''. ==Overall== The heavy weight and excellent Attack capabilities of '''AeroPegasus''' make it a staple Blade. <onlyinclude>Hasbro's '''Astral''' is a dual-spin Balance Type QD Blade based on Takara Tomy's [[Blade - Astral (Takara Tomy)|Astral]] Blade. '''Astral''' has a shape that is similar to its Takara Tomy counterpart's left-spin mode. Unlike Takara Tomy's Astral, Hasbro's '''Astral''' does not flip to switch between spin directions, instead using the same side (based on the Takara Tomy version's left-spin mode). Furthermore, '''Astral''' is a single plastic piece and lacks the rubber and metal blades of the Takara Tomy version, instead painting parts of the Blade to resemble the Takara Tomy version's rubber. '''Astral''' is also hollow on its underside, leading to a lightweight Layer with no particular advantages and a bad shape for either spin direction. Like other QD Blades, '''Astral''' can switch between Apex and Core Modes by swapping the position of the Gravity Ring from the top of the Blade (Apex) to below it (Core).</onlyinclude>

'''Devil''' is nearly identical to the [[Blade - Dynamite|Dynamite]] Blade in weight, shape, and performance; the most notable difference is a devil wing texture design on its three blades. While intended for Attack combinations, '''Devil''' has poor Attack performance due to its light weight, and its contact points are too short and stubby.

'''Devil''' is compatible with the [[F Gear]] and [[L Gear]]. When the F Gear is attached, the perimeter of '''Devil''' becomes rounder, with the rubber of the F Gear filling in gaps between the three blades. This round perimeter makes '''Devil''' one of the strongest Stamina Type options in the metagame, alongside the [[BU Blade - Wind|Wind]] BU Blade. Compared to Wind, '''Devil''' has slightly higher performance against Same-Spin opponents. Its superb Stamina performance against both Same-Spin and Opposite-Spin opponents makes '''Devil''' and the F Gear a must-have in the Burst metagame.

Like all Blades, '''Devil''' can switch between Low and High Modes by swapping the position of the [[DB Core]] and the [[Armor]]. When the L Gear is used, '''Devil''' can only be used in High Mode; although this adds weight and increases performance, High Mode is primarily used in Opposite-Spin Stamina matchups. As there are better Blades to use in these matchups, '''Devil''' with L Gear is not recommended.

As a result of its high Stamina performance, '''Devil''' with F Gear has been a staple of the metagame since its release, and is one of the two strongest Stamina Layers in the game, alongside Wind.</onlyinclude>

==Description==
{{QuotePart
|quote = A right-spin Attack Type Blade that launches an explosive attack as if it was tearing apart the opponent with thin and sharp devil's wings.
|speaker = Official Description}}
<onlyinclude>Takara Tomy's '''Dynamite''' is a right-spin Attack Type Blade with three blades acting as the main contact points. While intended for Attack combinations, '''Dynamite''' has poor Attack performance due to its light weight, and its contact points are too short and stubby.

'''Dynamite''' is compatible with the [[F Gear]] and [[L Gear]]. When the F Gear is attached, the perimeter of '''Dynamite''' becomes rounder, with the rubber of the F Gear filling in gaps between the three blades. This round perimeter makes '''Dynamite''' one of the strongest Stamina Type options in the metagame, alongside the [[BU Blade - Wind|Wind]] BU Blade. Compared to Wind, '''Dynamite''' has slightly higher performance against Same-Spin opponents. Its superb Stamina performance against both Same-Spin and Opposite-Spin opponents makes '''Dynamite''' and the F Gear a must-have in the Burst metagame.

Like all Blades, '''Dynamite''' can switch between Low and High Modes by swapping the position of the [[DB Core]] and the [[Armor]]. When the L Gear is used, '''Dynamite''' can only be used in High Mode; although this adds weight and increases performance, High Mode is primarily used in Opposite-Spin Stamina matchups. As there are better Blades to use in these matchups, '''Dynamite''' with L Gear is not recommended.

As a result of its high Stamina performance, '''Dynamite''' with F Gear has been a staple of the metagame since its release, and is one of the two strongest Stamina Layers in the game, alongside Wind.</onlyinclude>

==Description==
<onlyinclude>Hasbro's '''Guilty''' is a left-spin Attack Type QD Blade based on the [[Blade - Guilty (Takara Tomy)|Takara Tomy Blade of the same name]]. Its general shape is similar to its Takara Tomy counterpart, with two small blades and two large blades akin to the [[Base - Zone|Zone]] Base. These blades are sloped upwards and are intended to produce [[Upper Attack]]; however, when compared to its Takara Tomy counterpart, the blades are shorter with rounded edges, and the slope is less steep.

A further difference between Hasbro's '''Guilty''' and Takara Tomy's is the lack of metal. The original Takara Tomy Guilty featured six metal dragon heads riveted to the Blade, with four on the top and two on its underside. Hasbro's dragon heads are instead plastic and molded as part of the Blade, which is a single piece. The underside has been hollowed out, and thus Hasbro's '''Guilty''' lacks the two underside dragon heads. Furthermore, only two of the four dragon heads are painted to imitate the look of metal.

The less aggressive design of the blades, combined with the 10 gram reduction in weight due to the lack of metal, means Hasbro's '''Guilty''' has very poor Attack capabilities. The modified blades have poor [[Smash Attack]] as they hit weaker, and the light weight means Hasbro's '''Guilty''' has low Knock-Out and Burst Attack potential. While its Takara Tomy counterpart has remained a staple part since its release, in contrast Hasbro's '''Guilty''' performs worse than its predecessors such as [[Layer - Nightmare Luinor L3|Nightmare Lúinor L3]].</onlyinclude>

==Description==
{{QuotePart
|quote = Guilty is a left-spin Attack Type Blade with four dragons on the top and two dragons on the reverse, which can make heavy metal attacks and [[Upper Attack]]s, in addition to attacks from above.

<onlyinclude>Takara Tomy's '''Guilty''' is a left-spin Attack Type Blade with two small blades and two large blades, and is almost identical in shape to its predecessor, the [[Base - Zwei|Zwei]] Base, albeit larger. The aggressive shape of '''Guilty'''<nowiki/>'s blades produce excellent [[Smash Attack]], and are sloped upwards to produce [[Upper Attack]]. '''Guilty''' has the most powerful Smash Attack in the game, due to a combination of its aggressive design, wide shape, and excellent Outward Weight Distribution (OWD).

'''Guilty''' features six of the signature metal dragon heads of the Longinus line of Layers: four are located on the top of the large blades, with two on the underside. The six metal dragon heads results in a very heavy weight; '''Guilty''' is the heaviest Blade in the Dynamite Battle Layer System, at 17 grams. The heavy weight of '''Guilty''' creates high inertia which increases the Layer's Knockout (KO) and Burst Attack potential.

The heavy weight of '''Guilty''' requires Attack Type Drivers with rubber flat tips, which have higher speeds than plastic-tipped Drivers. Furthermore, as a result of its aggressive design, '''Guilty''' also has significant recoil. As such, Drivers such as [[Driver - Xtreme'|Xtreme']] and [[Driver - Quick'|Quick']] are recommended, as they have controllable movement patterns that help control '''Guilty'''<nowiki/>'s recoil. However, in wide stadiums such as the [[Beystadium DB Standard Type]], traditional Attack Type Drivers are weaker as the chance of knocking out opponents is reduced. Thus, Drivers with high Stamina and Life-After-Death (LAD), such as [[Driver - Metal Universe|Metal Universe]] and [[Driver - Zone'+Z|Zone'+Z]], are recommended.

As a result of its high performance, '''Guilty''' has remained a staple of the meta since its release, and is the strongest left-spin Attack Type Layer in the game.</onlyinclude>

The Gear Chip features the side profile of the [[wikipedia:Azure Dragon|Blue Dragon (Seiryū)]], one of the [[wikipedia:Four Symbols|Four Auspicious Beasts]] from Chinese mythology. Like the other Team Pendragon Beyblades, the Gear Chip has the ''Bakuten Shoot Beyblade'' logo, in this case being on the dragon's neck. As part of the ''[[Unique Line]]'', '''ImpactDrake''' has rubber Launcher Hooks instead of metal ones, which increase Outward Weight Distribution (OWD). At the time of its release, '''ImpactDrake''' was the heaviest Blade available, weighing 39 grams on average. However, these contact points will wear down with use, with the metal denting in a manner similar to the wear issues of the [[Blade - DranSword|DranSword]] Blade. ==Description==
<onlyinclude>Hasbro's '''Katana''' is a round right-spin Stamina Type QD Blade featuring a design with two hands holding [[wikipedia:Muramasa|Muramasa]] [[wikipedia:Katana|katana]] swords. The round shape of '''Katana''' creates decent Outward Weight Distribution (OWD), however its light weight and sloped sides make it outclassed by other Energy Layers for Stamina Combinations. Like other QD Blades, '''Katana''' can switch between Apex and Core Modes by swapping the position of the Gravity Ring from the top of the Blade (Apex) to below it (Core).

Despite its Stamina Type classification and round shape, '''Katana''' is thin with a hollow underside, making it lighter than other Stamina Type Blades. Its perimeter is also slightly sloped, and its weight distribution is unimpressive due to the hollow underside. '''Katana''' is consequently outclassed by thicker and heavier Stamina Type Blades such as [[QS Blade - Gambit|Gambit]] and [[QS Blade - Whirl|Whirl]].</onlyinclude>

==Description==<!--
{{QuotePart
|quote =
|speaker = Official Description}}-->
<onlyinclude>"Lightning L-Drago" can refer to 2 left-spin Attack Type Blades and [[X-Over Project]] adaptations of the [[Face Bolt - L-Drago I|L-Drago I Face]], [[Energy Ring - L-Drago I|L-Drago I Clear Wheel]], and [[Fusion Wheel - Lightning|Lightning Metal Wheel]] that came with the [[Metal Series]]' [[Hybrid Wheel System]] Beyblade, [[Lightning L-Drago 100HF]]. Due to the design of the system, the Blade parts are not customizable. As a result, the "Lightning L-Drago" Blades lack the mode change gimmick of the original parts, instead separating the Upper and Rapid-Hit Modes as two separate Blades: the "[[Blade - Lightning L-Drago (Upper Type)|Lightning L-Drago (Upper Type)]]" Blade and the "'''Lightning L-Drago (Rapid-Hit Type)'''" Blade. Like the original parts' Rapid-Hit Mode, the '''Lightning L-Drago (Rapid-Hit Type)''' Blade has three sets of three ridged protrusions that act as the main contact points, which can be used for rapid attacks.

Both "Lightning L-Drago" Blades are unstable due to each of the three contact points being hollowed differently. The instability creates highly inconsistent and erratic movement, causing shaking and wobbling that drains Stamina. While the Upper Type has a higher weight than the Rapid-Hit Type on average, the slight difference in shape means the Upper Type is more favorable for Attack.

===Rulings===
Official tournaments held by [[Beyblade Battle Base]] (B4) treat both "Lightning L-Drago" Blades as the same Blade.<ref name="YouTube">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yTZLV18XcL8 Official video]</ref> As such, only 1 of the 2 "Lightning L-Drago" Blades can be used in a [[3on3 Battle]] deck.<ref name="YouTube"/> In addition, they cannot be swapped with each other during a Match, as parts cannot be exchanged between Battles after Bey checks.<ref name="Regulations">[https://takaratomyasia.com/img/beybladex/1723513726_Regulation%20ver.5%20English%20ver..pdf BEYBLADE X Regulations 5th edition]</ref>

Ranked tournaments held by the [[World Beyblade Organization]] (WBO) use the same ruling.<ref name="Sep17">[https://worldbeyblade.org/Thread-WBO-Organized-Play-Updates-September-2024-X-Spreadsheets-Lightning-Blades-and-More WBO Organized Play Updates September 2024]</ref></onlyinclude>

}}{{Translation|'''Prominence'''|プロミネンス|Purominensu}} is a [[Blade]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Burst System]] as well as the [[Dynamite Battle Layer System]]. It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-191 [[Overdrive Special Starter Set]] on October 2nd, 2021.

==Description==
{{QuotePart
|quote = A right-spin Defense Type Blade that has two modes depending on the direction in which the Prominence Shield is attached. When the Blade receives a strong attack, the Prominence Shield comes off to release the impact and prevent bursts.
|speaker = Official Description}}
<onlyinclude>Takara Tomy's '''Prominence''' is a right-spin Defense Type Blade with a wide round perimeter. Like its predecessors, the [[Layer - Revive Phoenix|Revive Phoenix]] and [[Layer - Dead Phoenix|Dead Phoenix]] Cho-Z Layers, '''Prominence''' has the "[[Prominence Shield]]" attached to the Blade via a locking mechanism. The Prominence Shield can be attached vertically or horizontally; depending on the orientation, '''Prominence''' is either in "Normal Mode" or "Heavy Mode". In its Normal Mode, the Prominence Shield is easier to knock off during battle. The loss of the the Prominence Shield makes the Blade lighter, but the smoother perimeter created reduces the chance of a Burst. In its Heavy Mode, the Prominence Shield is more difficult to knock off as it is impeded by the Armor locking mechanism. When the Prominence Shield is knocked off and left in the Stadium, it can interfere with the opponent and impede Banking Patterns and reduce Stamina. 

Due to its weight distribution, '''Prominence''' performs poorly against Same-Spin opponents utilizing popular right-spin Blades like [[BU Blade - Wind|Wind]]. Furthermore, if the Prominence Shield is knocked off, its Stamina is severely reduced. '''Prominence''' finds some use against left-spin Opposite-Spin opponents, and the Heavy Mode is recommended to avoid the reduction in Stamina.

The primary usage of '''Prominence''' is in pure Defense combinations against right-spin Attackers. The Prominence Shield will absorb much of the impact from attacks; although it can also be used against left-spin Attackers like [[Blade - Guilty (Takara Tomy)|Guilty]], it is not as effective against left-spin Attackers as Blades such as [[BU Blade - Barricade|Barricade]]. However, if the Prominence Shield is knocked off, '''Prominence''' is vulnerable to Knockout (KO) Attack.</onlyinclude>

==Description==
<onlyinclude>Hasbro's '''Salvage''' is a right-spin Attack Type QD Blade based on Takara Tomy's [[Blade - Savior|Savior]] Blade. '''Salvage''' has a three-sided shape that is similar to its Takara Tomy counterpart, with three upward slanted wings as the primary points of contact, akin to its predecessors in the Valtryek line of Layers. The main difference between Hasbro's '''Salvage''' and Takara Tomy's Savior is the lack of rubber. The original Takara Tomy Savior Blade featured an "Awakening" gimmick, where the rubber pieces would eventually wear down and break off, increasing Attack potential. However, '''Salvage''' instead has these "blades" made of plastic rather than rubber, and are thus meant to be permanently affixed. Despite the three wings being shorter and rounded at the ends, the three-sided design creates moderate Attack potential. Like other QD Blades, '''Salvage''' can switch between Apex and Core Modes by swapping the position of the Gravity Ring from the top of the Blade (Apex) to below it (Core).</onlyinclude>

==Overall==
<tabber>
|-|Burst=

'''As such, Salvage is not a must have but is instead a welcome addition for the Burst Limited Format.'''

==Description==
{{QuotePart
|quote = A right-spin Attack Type Blade that uses a rubber blade to repel the opponent. When worn down, the Blade is Awakened, unleashing a powerful increase in Attack performance.
|speaker = Official Description}}
<onlyinclude>Takara Tomy's '''Savior''' is a right-spin Attack Type Blade with three plastic "wings" acting as the main contact points. The plastic wings are lined with rubber, which are meant to repel opponents. A unique feature of the '''Savior''' Blade are three rubber nubs that are meant to wear and break off over time, "Awakening" the '''Savior''' Blade. Once "Awakened", the shape of '''Savior''' becomes closer to a traditional three-sided Attack Type shape, with the wings being more exposed and no longer having the rubber nubs interfering with contact.

Due to the increase in Attack power, the "Awakened" form of '''Savior''' is the stronger one. This makes an Awakened '''Savior''' an excellent choice for Knockout (KO) and Burst Attack combinations. However, a drawback of the '''Savior''' Blade is the aggressive shape creates high amounts of recoil, which can cause Bursts. As such, a DB Core such as [[DB Core - Belial 2|Belial 2]] or [[DB Core - Belial 3|Belial 3]] is recommended, as they have "Burst Lock" tabs that prevent Bursts. Furthermore, a notable issue with '''Savior''' is a widespread issue that occurs with the tips of the three plastic wings, which are prone to breakage after prolonged use.</onlyinclude>

==Overall==
<tabber>
|-|Burst=
In its "Awakened" form, '''Savior''' is an excellent choice for Attack combinations, although a drawback is its high recoil. While right-spin Attack Blades such as [[Blade - Ultimate (Takara Tomy)|Ultimate]] and [[BU Blade - Xiphoid|Xiphoid]] have higher Knockout (KO) and Burst Attack potential, an Awakened '''Savior''' is still viable in the format.

==Description==
{{QuotePart
|quote = A right-spin Attack Type Blade with a design based on previous Valkyrie Beyblades, which features a sharp V-shaped rubber blade that strikes the opponent and a large upper blade that knocks away the opponent.
|speaker = Official Description}}
<onlyinclude>Takara Tomy's '''Ultimate''' is a right-spin Attack Type Blade with three V-shaped "wings" acting as the main contact points. The wings have rubber covering the contact points, which are meant to create [[Smash Attack]]. The overall shape of '''Ultimate''' is based on the original [[Layer - Valkyrie|Valkyrie]] Layer, with detailing based on the [[Layer - Winning Valkyrie|Winning Valkyrie]], rubber based on the [[Blade - Savior|Savior]] Blade, and "air duct" holes based on the [[Base - Slash|Slash]] Blade. Compared to its predecessor in the [[Dynamite Battle Layer System]], Takara Tomy's '''Ultimate''' has the same Attack capabilities due to its aggressive shape, but a reduction in runaway recoil, reducing the risk of Self-Bursts and Self-KOs. Over time, the rubber of '''Ultimate''' can wear down, until the plastic part of the wings become the main contact points. This results in a much greater amount of [[Smash Attack]], but also a high amount of recoil.

Like all Blades, '''Ultimate''' can switch between Low and High Modes by swapping the position of the [[DB Core]] and the [[Armor]].</onlyinclude>

==Overall==
<tabber>
|-|Burst=
A worn down '''Ultimate''' (where the plastic part of the wings are the main contact points) has incredibly high amounts of Smash Attack, making '''Ultimate''' an excellent choice for right-spin Attack combinations. However, other Attack Blade options such as the right-spin [[BU Blade - Xiphoid|Xiphoid]] and the left-spin [[Blade - Guilty (Takara Tomy)|Guilty]], do not require wearing down the Blade for performance. Furthermore, the aforementioned Blades may be preferable over '''Ultimate''' as they have less self-destructive recoil.

'''As such, Takara Tomy's Ultimate is not a must-have, but a welcome addition for the WBO's Burst format.'''

==Description==
<onlyinclude>
{{QuotePart
|quote = A left-spin Stamina Type Blade that is entirely made of rubber and has a hole that allows the flexible blade to absorb the rotation of the opponent.
|speaker = Official Description}}
Takara Tomy's '''Vanish''' is a round left-spin Stamina Type Blade with three dragon heads akin to its predecessors in the Fafnir Energy Layer line. Like its predecessors, '''Vanish''' has a "F" formed by the area between each of the dragon heads, meant to represent '''F'''afnir. Unlike other Blades, '''Vanish''' is completely made of rubber, which is intended to increase its [[Spin Absorption|spin absorption]]] capabilities by making all contact points rubber. Between each of the plastic dragon heads are flexible blades with holes that are intended for shock absorption; when an opponent collides with that particular section, the rubber flexes inwards, absorbing the impact. The thick round shape and rubber composition creates superb Stamina performance against both Same-Spin and Opposite-Spin opponents, which is further enhanced by its spin absorption capabilities.

Like all Blades, '''Vanish''' can switch between Low and High Modes by swapping the position of the [[DB Core]] and the [[Armor]].</onlyinclude>

==Use in Defense/Stamina Spin-Absorption Combinations==
'''Vanish''' can be put to use in the Defense/Stamina spin-absorption combination '''Vanish''' Bahamut/Longinus Over/Giga/Tapered Bearing'/Drift/High Xtend+'. The Bahamut DB Core offers high Burst Resistance, while the Longinus DB Core increases the weight of the Combination further. Furthermore, the poor Knockout (KO) Resistance of Bearing' and Drift is mitigated by the heavy weight of '''Vanish''' and the Forge Discs Over/Giga/Tapered. When against an Opposite-Spin opponent, the rubber of '''Vanish''' and the low friction of the Bearing'/Drift/High Xtend+' Performance Tip allows for high amounts of spin absorption, which combined with the high Life-After-Death (LAD) of Over/Giga/Tapered, allows the Combination to Out-Spin its opponent.

If '''WizardRod''' was used in a combo, the opponent would receive 1 point at the beginning of the match.[https://beyblade.takaratomy.co.jp/beyblade-x/event/g2_tobuzoocup2024.html Tobu Zoo Cup page] On February 15th, 2025, [[Beyblade Battle Base]] (B4) announced that '''WizardRod''' would be added to the "[[Hall of Fame (Beyblade X)|Hall of Fame]]", a list that restricts parts from official B4 tournaments. '''WizardRod''' was banned from [[1on1 Battle]] and [[3-Blader Battle]] matches, with the ban taking effect on April 1st, 2025 with the 7th Edition of the Beyblade X Regulations. '''WizardRod''' could however still be used in [[3on3 Battle]] and [[Team Battle]] matches.[https://twitter.com/tbh_pr/status/1890607541220250013 Twitter post from Beyblade X development team] At the time of writing, the [[World Beyblade Organization]] (WBO) has no similar restrictions for '''WizardRod''', or any part. ==Overall== '''WizardRod''''s heavy weight and round shape make it a staple Blade for Stamina Type combinations. G1669 (Hasbro) |Classification=Bit |Type=Balance |Weight=3.2 grams |System=Basic Line |Series=Beyblade X |ReleaseJP=September 14th, 2024 |ReleaseUS=May 2025 |ReleaseCA=June 2025 |AttackStat=30 |DefenseStat=15 |StaminaStat=20 |DashStat=35 |BurstResistanceStat=30 |XStandard=✔️ }}{{Translation|'''Elevate'''|エレベート|Erebēto}} is a [[Bit]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Basic Line]] system. It debuted in Japan with the release of the BX-36 [[Random Booster WhaleWave Select]] on September 14th, 2024. It later debuted in western countries with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s Booster Pack, [[Tide Whale 5-80E]]. ==Description== '''Elevate''' or '''E''' is a Balance Type Bit that features a flat tip with a bump protruding in the center, and a large disc surrounding it. The wide ring is intended to 'elevate' the Bit above the Stadium floor during an [[Xtreme Dash]], preventing Stamina loss. The elevated Bit also allows an '''Elevate''' combo to more easily do [[Smash Attack]]s with an Xtreme Dash. The smooth perimeter of the ring also provides Life-After-Death (LAD) potential. This LAD allows an '''Elevate''' combo to roll on the disc when tilted or swaying at the end of a battle. Although it is a Balance Type Bit, '''Elevate''' has a weak Burst Lock (low Burst Resistance) shaft that is usually found on Stamina Type Bits. This was done to balance its high performance.[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ihhz4b_B36M WhaleWave official video] Upon release, '''Elevate''' quickly became prominently used with the [[Blade - CobaltDragoon|CobaltDragoon]] Blade that had been released 2 months earlier. At the time Cobalt Dragoon had not yet become prominent in the metagame, with Bladers experimenting with Bits such as [[Bit - Glide|Glide (G)]] to achieve mixed results in Opposite-Spin Stamina matchups. With '''Elevate''', the combo [[Blade - CobaltDragoon|CobaltDragoon]] [[Ratchet - 5-60|5-60]][[Bit - Elevate|E]] became a popular counterpick to the popular [[Blade - WizardRod|WizardRod]] [[Ratchet - 3-60|3-60]][[Bit - Ball|B]] combo, which had been frequently used in tournaments. Unlike previous Cobalt Dragoon combos, combos utilizing '''Elevate''' were able to destabilize the opponent's [[Blade - WizardRod|WizardRod]] [[Ratchet - 3-60|3-60]][[Bit - Ball|B]] combo when launched correctly. The combo was also recommended by Takara Tomy in several publications, including the [[CoroCoro Comic]] magazine and the inserts included with the [[Random Booster WhaleWave Select]]. This combo also saw usage during the [[Asia Championship 2024]] and the qualification tournaments preceding it. ==Overall== ==Products== ===Takara Tomy=== * BX-36 [[Random Booster WhaleWave Select]] - 01: [[WhaleWave 5-80E]] * BX-48 [[Random Booster Vol. 9]] - 02: [[SharkEdge 4-70E]] * BX-00 [[MammothTusk 2-80E]] * CX-00 [[Evangelion Deck Set]] - [[EvaArc B0-70E]] (Unit-00 Version) * UX-12 [[Random Booster Vol. 5]] - 04: [[LeonClaw 0-80E]] ===Hasbro=== * G1669 [[Tide Whale 5-80E]] * G3061 [[Grogu and Snowtrooper Multipack Set]] - [[Grogu 3-85E]] ==Gallery== BitElevatePrototype.png|Elevate (BX-36; Initial Prototype) BitElevate.png|Elevate (BX-36; Second Prototype) Elevate (BX-00).png|Elevate (BX-00) Elevate (Grogu).png|Elevate (G3061) ==Trivia== *The original Attack Type design of '''Elevate''' had a decagonal guard instead of a disk, and no bump protruding from the bottom, creating a wide flat tip. It later debuted in western countries with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s [[Calibur Samurai and Obsidian Shell Dual Pack]]. ==Description== '''Merge''' or '''M''' is a Balance Type Bit that features a flat rubber tip, with a plastic sharp tip protruding from the center. When '''Merge''' is knocked off balance by an opponent or launched at an angle, the outer rubber tip will contact the stadium floor, creating aggressive movement. When launched parallel to the stadium floor, the '''Merge''' combo will spin on the plastic sharp, and go back to the center of the stadium. '''Merge''' is the first Bit to feature 18 gears instead of the standard 12, increasing the speed of a '''Merge''' combo's Xtreme Dash, at the cost of Stamina. '''Merge''' is also 4 millimeter taller than the standard Bit height, with taller gears and a larger area between the gears and the area that contacts the Ratchet of the combo. Due to the additional height, '''Merge''' is also the heaviest Bit at its release, being slightly heavier than Elevate, which was previously the heaviest Bit. Like Elevate, '''Merge''' appears to have undergone several revisions to its design; the [[SamuraiCalibur 6-70M]] product renders released by [[Takara Tomy]] and [[Hasbro]] display a '''Merge''' prototype at a standard height. ==Description==
{{QuotePart
|quote = The Wedge Bit's angled tip is now surrounded by a cylindrical wall, further reducing tilting.
|speaker = Official Description}}
<onlyinclude>'''Wall Wedge''' or '''WW''' is a Defense Type Bit that is a variant of the standard [[Bit - Wedge|Wedge]] Bit. It has added the same "wall" design previously seen with the [[Bit - Wall Ball|Wall Ball (WB)]] Bit, which is intended to reduce tilting by pushing the Bey upright when the wall touches the stadium floor. '''Wall Wedge''' retains the same small diameter sharp tip as Wedge, which generates high Stamina, and settles in the center of the stadium. Unlike Wedge, which had a decreased 10-tooth gear instead of the standard 12, '''Wall Wedge''' instead has a 16-tooth gear. Having additional teeth increases the speed of an Xtreme Dash at the cost of Stamina. As '''Wall Wedge''' is intended to be a Defense-type Bit, this is not desirable on a standard Defense combo. However, on [[Anti-Attack]] combos, this may be used to increase its Attack potential.</onlyinclude>

It is intended as an upgrade for [[DranBrave S6-60V]], replacing the Slash Assist Blade. At the time of writing, '''Heavy''' is the heaviest Assist Blade available, at an average weight of 7.8 grams. The design is best suited for Attack Type Main Blades, such as [[Main Blade - Brave|Brave (Courage)]] and [[Main Blade - Blast|Blast]], as the weight distribution amplifies the contact points, and unlike Assist Blades such as Wheel, '''Heavy''' allows the contact points to remain exposed. A special feature of '''Heavy''' is the addition of metal to increase centrifugal force and balance. Prior to the release of '''Heavy''', the heaviest Assist Blade was Wheel, which had an average weight of 7.2 grams. While Wheel was popular due to its heavy weight, its high 80-height round design meant Attack Type Main Blades had reduced Attack potential, but higher lategame Life-After-Death (LAD) rolling. As such, while Wheel is still favorable for Defense and Stamina builds, '''Heavy''' is an excellent choice for low-height Attack combinations. }}'''Antler''' is a [[Main Blade]] released by [[Hasbro]] as part of the [[Custom Line]] system. It debuted in western countries with the release of the Custom Line Starter Pack, [[Antler Stag B 2-60HN]]. It later debuted in Japan as {{Translation|'''Antlers'''|アントラーズ|Antorāzu}} with the release of the CX-00 B4 Limited Booster, [[BucksAntlers B2-60D]], on July 9th, 2026.

==Description==<!--
{{QuotePart
|quote = 
|speaker = Official Description}}-->
<onlyinclude>'''Antler''' is a circular Stamina Type Main Blade with three smooth contact points. '''Antler''' is a retool of [[Main Blade - Flame|Flame]], with the exact same metal components, but a new plastic component. While the plastic component of Flame had a total of 9 holes, the plastic component of '''Antler''' is completely filled in, with additional plastic covering the top of the metal. As a result, the plastic of '''Antler''' weighs 0.3 grams more than Flame. In addition, '''Antler''' appears to consistently have a heavier metal component than Flame, resulting in a higher weight overall.

'''Antler''' appeared on North American store shelves a month after Flame's release in Japan, in wave 6. It would not be until wave 7 that Hasbro released Flame, making this the third instance where a retool was released by Hasbro before the original part. The first instance was the [[Blade - LeonClaw|LeonClaw]] and [[Blade - Steel Samurai|SamuraiSteel]] Blades, followed by the [[Blade - ShelterDrake|ShelterDrake]] and [[Blade - Gill Shark|SharkGill]] Blades.

===Rulings===
'''Antler''' is treated as a different part from Flame, despite sharing the same metal components. Both '''Antler''' and Flame can be used in the same deck at [[World Beyblade Organization]] (WBO) ranked tournaments.</onlyinclude>

It later debuted in western countries with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s [[Clip & Rip Launcher Set]]. ==Description== The '''Blast''' Main Blade has three "wings" acting as the main contact points, similar to the previously released [[Main Blade - Brave|Brave (Courage)]] Main Blade. Compared to Brave, '''Blast''' is heavier and has more rounded contact points. As a result, '''Blast''' has comparable Attack power and greater Stamina compared to Brave. Since its release, '''Blast''' has primarily been paired with the [[Assist Blade - Wheel|Wheel]] Assist Blade, and later [[Assist Blade - Heavy|Heavy]]. It was also heavily paired with the [[Lock Chip - Valkyrie|Valkyrie (Valkerion)]] Metal Lock Chip, and later the [[Lock Chip - Emperor|Emperor]] Metal Lock Chip, which was more accessible. The general Attack performance of '''Blast''' is excellent against Stamina-type opponents, and its heavy weight allows '''Blast''' to excel in matchups against other Attack-type combos. However, the top-heavy nature of [[Custom Line]] combos such as '''Blast''' means a higher likelihood to topple at lower spin velocities. Compared to BX Blades such as [[Blade - PhoenixWing|PhoenixWing (Soar Phoenix)]] and UX Blades such as [[Blade - SharkScale|SharkScale (Scale Shark)]], '''Blast''' combos are more prone to Destabilization.
